title: 學華語向前走 2B — Lesson 11
description: Vocabulary from lesson 11 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2B, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.english: We're going to the zoo today.

exampleSentences.pinyin: dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù.
exampleSentences.english: There are lots of animals in the zoo.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週末爸爸帶我去動物園。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò bàba dài wǒ qù dòngwùyuán.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend Dad takes me to the zoo.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zài dòngwùyuán guò shēngrì.
exampleSentences.english: I want to have my birthday at the zoo.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ hé péngyou zài gōngyuán wán.
exampleSentences.english: My friend and I play in the park.
Do you want to play ball?

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàkè hòu wǒmen zài cāochǎng wán.
exampleSentences.english: After school we play on the playground.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 下雨了，我們不能出去玩。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàyǔ le, wǒmen bù néng chūqù wán.
exampleSentences.english: It's raining, so we can't go out to play.
I saw a little kitten.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ kàndào wǒ de shū le ma?
exampleSentences.english: Did you see my book?

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zài chuāngwài kàndào yì zhī niǎo.
exampleSentences.english: I saw a bird outside the window.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ kàn, wǒ kàndào cǎihóng le!
exampleSentences.english: Look, I can see a rainbow!
Elephants are very big.
This is an elephant.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 大象的鼻子很長，我喜歡牠。
exampleSentences.pinyin: dàxiàng de bízi hěn cháng, wǒ xǐhuan tā.
exampleSentences.english: An elephant's trunk is very long, and I like it.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de huà lǐ yǒu yì tóu dàxiàng.
exampleSentences.english: There's an elephant in my drawing.
Tigers have black stripes.
This tiger is very big.
My favourite animal is the tiger.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de lǎohǔ wánjù bújiàn le.
exampleSentences.english: My toy tiger is missing.
This time we're going to the zoo.
You go first this time.
This time I'm going to beat you!

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽說這一次要早點睡覺。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma shuō zhèyícì yào zǎodiǎn shuìjiào.
exampleSentences.english: Mum says we have to go to bed early this time.
I wish tomorrow will be a sunny day.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xīwàng nǐ xǐhuan zhè běn shū.
exampleSentences.english: I hope you like this book.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我希望下次和你一起玩。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xīwàng xiàcì hé nǐ yìqǐ wán.
exampleSentences.english: I hope we can play together next time.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我希望生日的時候有大蛋糕。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xīwàng shēngrì de shíhou yǒu dà dàngāo.
exampleSentences.english: I hope there's a big cake on my birthday.
Monkeys are very good at climbing trees.
That monkey is very small.
Monkeys love eating bananas.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 弟弟像猴子一樣跳來跳去。
exampleSentences.pinyin: dìdi xiàng hóuzi yíyàng tiào lái tiào qù.
exampleSentences.english: My little brother jumps around like a monkey.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 他不但會游泳，還會跑步。
exampleSentences.pinyin: tā búdàn huì yóuyǒng, hái huì pǎobù.
exampleSentences.english: He can not only swim, but also run.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我不但喜歡蘋果，還喜歡香蕉。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ búdàn xǐhuan píngguǒ, hái xǐhuan xiāngjiāo.
exampleSentences.english: I like not only apples but also bananas.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這個公園不但有滑梯，還有大樹。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège gōngyuán búdàn yǒu huátī, hái yǒu dà shù.
exampleSentences.english: This park has not only a slide but also big trees.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的狗不但很可愛，還很聰明。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de gǒu búdàn hěn kě'ài, hái hěn cōngmíng.
exampleSentences.english: My dog is not only cute but also clever.
Penguins are very cute.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這隻企鵝是黑色和白色的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè zhī qǐ'é shì hēisè hé báisè de.
exampleSentences.english: This penguin is black and white.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的書包上有一隻企鵝。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de shūbāo shàng yǒu yì zhī qǐ'é.
exampleSentences.english: There's a penguin on my school bag.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我每晚抱著企鵝娃娃睡覺。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ měi wǎn bàozhe qǐ'é wáwa shuìjiào.
exampleSentences.english: Every night I hug my penguin toy to sleep.
Pandas like to eat bamboo.
This is a panda.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù dòngwùyuán kàn xióngmāo.
exampleSentences.english: I want to go to the zoo to see the pandas.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de xióngmāo bǐdài hěn kě'ài.
exampleSentences.english: My panda pencil case is so cute.
The teacher is really nice.
This character is really hard to write.
It's really hot today!
Your cake is really yummy!
Giraffes are very tall.
Giraffes eat leaves from trees.
A giraffe's neck is very long.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的生日蛋糕上有一隻長頸鹿。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de shēngrì dàngāo shàng yǒu yì zhī chángjǐnglù.
exampleSentences.english: My birthday cake has a giraffe on it.
This is my neck.
The neck is below the head.
My neck hurts a little.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ dài wéijīn, bózi bù lěng.
exampleSentences.english: I wear a scarf, so my neck isn't cold.
Pandas are chubby.
This cat is chubby.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的小狗吃得很多，變胖了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de xiǎogǒu chī de hěn duō, biàn pàng le.
exampleSentences.english: My puppy eats a lot and has got chubby.
My teddy bear is nice and chubby.
This road is very long.
My hair is long.
My skipping rope is long.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 放學的路很長，我們走了很久。
exampleSentences.pinyin: fàngxué de lù hěn cháng, wǒmen zǒu le hěn jiǔ.
exampleSentences.english: The walk home from school was long; we walked for ages.
This rope is very short.
Today's lesson is short.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的頭髮很短，媽媽剪的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de tóufa hěn duǎn, māma jiǎn de.
exampleSentences.english: My hair is short; Mum cut it.
The puppy's tail is short and stubby.
